title: Limits of Discovery and Health
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Limits of Discovery and Health.
learning_objectives: Explain limits of discovery and health using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for limits of discovery and health
Assess failure and operational limits of limits of discovery and health
concepts_covered: Finding an endpoint does not prove that it is ready or safe to receive traffic.
Discovery runs when called; health is manually marked; no probe loop or TLS manager is implemented.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
